project_type: Python FastAPI app - Autonomous AI Company Operating System
test_framework: pytest with pytest-asyncio (asyncio_mode=auto), tests in tests/ directory, mock-based (no real DB needed)
verification_instructions: Run python3.12 -m pytest -x -q and confirm all tests pass (baseline: 1081 tests)
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET network mode. Python 3.12 available at /usr/bin/python3.12. Do NOT touch dashboard/ directory.
contribution_requirements: All new code must have proper docstrings, type hints, follow ruff style (100 char lines). Python 3.12 features (type unions with |). Every module independently testable. New SQLModel tables added to src/nexus/models/__init__.py for Alembic discovery.
key_patterns: In-memory class-based services (no real DB dependency in unit tests). Dataclass for DTOs. SQLModel for DB tables. Async methods for I/O operations. Tests use pytest fixtures from tests/conftest.py. Each module has its own __init__.py exporting public API. Test file naming: tests/test_<module>.py
directory_structure: src/nexus/ is the main package. Key subdirs: governance/ (budget, kill switch, circuit breaker), communication/ (a2a, channels, event_bus, group), runtime/ (adapter, lifecycle, executor, cycle_guard, heartbeat, watchdog), models_router/ (router, cost_tracker, providers), workflows/ (company_flow, task_flow), models/ (SQLModel tables). Tests in tests/ at project root.
